about.title: What is Stick It to the Stickman?
paragraphs: Stick It to the Stickman is a rogue-lite physics brawler developed by Free Lives and published by Devolver Digital. You fight your way through a hostile workplace, chaining punches, kicks, stabs, stapling, and chainsaw strikes into your own combat combinations while climbing the corporate ladder toward becoming CEO.

Every run unlocks new workers, archetypes like Temps, Caffeine Addicts, and Ego Maniacs, and extra game modes such as Foreign Manufacturing and Neurolink. Bring a friend with couch co-op or Remote Play Together, or try the free demo before your first full climb.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Stick It to the Stickman.

items.question: What kind of game is Stick It to the Stickman?
items.answer: Stick It to the Stickman is a rogue-lite physics brawler built around fighting coworkers and executives, chaining combat moves, using weapons and superpowers, and climbing the corporate ladder.

items.question: Who developed and published Stick It to the Stickman?
items.answer: Stick It to the Stickman was developed by Free Lives and published by Devolver Digital.

items.question: When did Stick It to the Stickman fully release?
items.answer: The full 1.0 release of Stick It to the Stickman launched on September 23, 2026. The game had previously entered Steam Early Access on August 18, 2025.

items.question: Which platforms officially support Stick It to the Stickman?
items.answer: The official Steam listing for Stick It to the Stickman provides Windows and macOS system requirements.

items.question: Does Stick It to the Stickman support co-op?
items.answer: Yes. The Steam listing for Stick It to the Stickman identifies shared and split-screen co-op as well as Remote Play Together, and the game description specifically mentions couch co-op.

items.question: Does Stick It to the Stickman have multiple game modes?
items.answer: Yes. Stick It to the Stickman has multiple game modes, including Foreign Manufacturing and Neurolink, with additional modes and content added during development and the move to 1.0.

items.question: Is there an official Stick It to the Stickman demo?
items.answer: Yes. The official Steam store page for Stick It to the Stickman provides a downloadable demo, and the official game website also promotes the demo.

items.question: Are there official redeemable codes for Stick It to the Stickman?
items.answer: No official redeemable-code system or verified code list for Stick It to the Stickman was established in the reviewed official game site, Steam store, publisher page, or official Steam announcements, so no codes are asserted here.
